label: PF Backlog 631
title: UIUX knowledge ingestion (guidelines, design-systems, samples)
body:
## Problem / why
docs/guidelines/ui-ux holds only a dated WCAG-2.1 accessibility.md; the UIUX/ corpus is unused.

## Goal & value
Distill UIUX/ into PF guidelines + reference baselines the existing loader already injects.

## In scope
- Add docs/guidelines/ui-ux/* (principles, anti-patterns, foundations, components, patterns, design-selection, stack, trends).
- Upgrade accessibility.md to WCAG 2.2 AA.
- Add docs/guidelines/design-systems/* (18) and docs/reference/uiux-samples/*; register allow-globs.

## Out of scope
- Authoring NEW design systems beyond the 18 sampled.

## Definition of Done
- docs served; no derived file hand-edited.
- store-registry allow-globs present.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
